description: Geothermal Exploration Cost and Time Metric is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) was tasked with developing a metric in 2012 to measure the impacts of RD&D funding on the cost and time required for geothermal exploration activities. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Energy, Geothermal Energy. Its keywords are geothermal, exploration, cost, time, tool, risk. The portal shows 2017-05-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
